story.title: Ghost Disaster
paragraphs_en: Once upon a time there lived a farmer in a village called Machavaram, he had a son whose name was Naani. They lived far away from the village which was located near the burial ground. It was peak summer, and every one used to sleep outside their house. That day too people slept outside their house, Srinivas slept a little far from his house than others.

Next day morning, Srinivas was not to be found in the place where he slept. While Naani was searching for his father, Srinivas was walking towards their house with a cot on his shoulder. Naani inquired his father about his disappearance. But Srinivas did not tell anything about his disappearance. But Naani wanted to know the truth at any cost.

Naani wanted to know the truth. He was awake and was watching his father who was sleeping outside the house as usual. The time moved on, it was 10 pm... it was 11 pm and slowly it was 12 now. Suddenly Naani saw a group of people walking towards the village. Naani was keenly observing them, he was scared too. The group was walking towards their house.

He was sweating as he was scared but he did not close his eyes. The group reached their house. Naani was shocked to see them.. They were.. they were.. ﻿Ghosts. ﻿ The ghosts lifted Srinivas's bed and walked towards the burial ground. Naani did not know what to do, he wanted to save his father. He got an idea, he took a big stick and

after the ghosts. When he reached near he hit ghosts with his stick. Meanwhile Naani's father woke up, he too started hitting the ghosts. The ghosts ran away from there. Srinivas praised his son's bravery and told the whole story to his wife. The villagers came to know about the whole ﻿Ghost's Problem ﻿. They were happy that they got rid of the problem.
